# The coord language — grounding pack (taifoon.pipe.lang.v1, generated; do not edit)

Every envelope is a transition. A READ arrives as kind `observe` from the producer (GET /v1/pipe/stream); a WRITE is sent with POST /v1/pipe/send, names its transition, carries the transition's kind, and writes to one outlet the caller's key holds.

Kinds a send may carry: offer, hire, delivery, grade, settle, release, advert, cover, ack, record. Read-only kinds: observe.
Outlets: mainnet, devnet, taifoon, vaults. Vault venues write to `vaults`; eip155:36927 → devnet; eip155:3692781 → taifoon; any other chain → mainnet; a watch or an http delivery writes to no outlet.

Carrier routes (first match wins):
1. record: agent_is=audit, venue_is=coord, kinds=record
2. watch: venue_is=coord, endpoint=absent, kinds=hire|settle|release|delivery
3. http: endpoint=http, kinds=any
4. solana: chain_prefix=solana, kinds=settle|release
5. venue: venue=present, kinds=any
6. evm: chain_prefix=eip155:, kinds=settle|release
7. solana: chain_prefix=solana, agent=present, kinds=any
